note: The input-controlled SAM header is parsed as @PG records, so program-line state enters the header record table.
The PP tags from the candidate create links between the two @PG records.
When the program links are rebuilt, each input PP value is resolved back to another @PG record.
Both entries in the cycle are marked non-endpoints; the code must not leave any negative pg_end entry to be consumed as an index.
With no valid chain end, the fallback copies the last existing pg_end slot, which is -1 for the cycle.
The negative value propagated through end[i] is used as an array subscript, causing an out-of-bounds read before the pg array.
